inscriptions.inscription_remark: This page contains a colophon stating that the manuscript of the Kalakacharya-katha was written in Prahladanpur, which is modern-day Palanpur in Gujarat, on the 11th day of the month of Ashadha in the year 1335 of the Vikrama Era, which is equivalent to 1278.

description: Wearing white billowing monastic robes, the two nuns contrast with the beautifully adorned laywomen, who wear elaborately patterned textiles and jewelry. Jains commissioned illuminated manuscripts as a way to accrue religious merit, and they would have images of themselves at prayer inserted into the image cycles like this as signs of their patronage.
